Աշխատում եմ film-crew → seedance-25-director-ով.

I planned the promo as a short film-crew pass and turned it into one Seedance 2.5 generation. You lay the voice-over and the logo over it afterwards in your editor.

**Before the plan:**
- This folder isn't a git repo and has no `NOTES.md`, so I couldn't pull or check open items. I changed no files, so nothing needs a notes entry or a push.
- The only locked fact I found about this project is the one in `maghakian-roast-room/business.md`: "original Armenian content, ages 0 to 16". There are no locked characters, so I made up the girl and her look below.

**What I assumed:**
- There are no reference images, so the video is generated from text alone.
- The voice-over is **not** uploaded to Seedance. It could redub, mix or change the timing of your Armenian recording. The clip comes out with room sound only and you lay the VO on top.
- AI-made lettering, especially Armenian, often comes out garbled. So there is no text in the video, and the last shot keeps the top part of the frame dark and empty for the logo.
- Brand colours: the shadows are black and graphite, and the single red accent is the book's cover (#D90429).

## Shot plan (cut to the VO)

The look is warm and intimate, with the camera at a child's eye level. A cold blue window and a warm amber lamp carry the idea of a question being answered. There are 3 shots over 15 s, about 5 s each, so each line gets one image.

| # | Time | VO | Shot | Cut out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0–4 s | "Every child has a question nobody answered." | At night a girl of about 7 kneels at the window with her palm on the glass, looking up. Cold moonlight from the left. Slow push-in to a close-up of her eyes looking up. | Hard cut at 4.0 s, in the silence before line 2. Her eyes go from looking **up** to looking **down** at the book. |
| 2 | 4–9.5 s | "We write the books that answer it — in Armenian." | Top-down on the red book as her hands open it under the warm lamp. The camera rises in one move to her face lit by the page as a small smile forms. | Hard cut at 9.5 s, on the word "Maghakian". The view goes from close-up to wide; warm light on the right and cold light on the left stay the same. |
| 3 | 9.5–15 s | "Maghakian Scripts. Books for ages zero to sixteen." | A toddler, the girl with the red book and a teenager read under one lamp. Very slow pull-back. The top 40% of the frame is a dark empty wall, and the image holds still from 13.5 s. | End card. |

**Sound:** room sound only (night hum, the book's cloth cover creaking, pages, the lamp). No music in the generation; add music in the edit under the VO if you want it.

**Text you add in the edit**, in the dark top area of shot 3:
- 9.5 s: the Maghakian Scripts logo in white.
- 11.5 s: «Գրքեր 0-ից 16 տարեկանների համար», with a thin red #D90429 line under it.

**Risks:**
- Cuts inside one generation can drift by ±0.3 s. Fix this in the edit with trims, or use the fallback below.
- Three different ages in one frame may come out with ages blended. If that happens, regenerate shot 3 on its own.

**Fallback (three separate clips):** if the cuts or the girl's face don't hold, generate each shot as its own clip using the matching section of the prompt: 4 s, 6 s and 6 s. Then trim them to 4 / 5.5 / 5.5 s.

## FINAL

**Settings (Dreamina, Seedance 2.5):**
- **Mode:** Omni Reference, text only, no uploads
- **Duration:** 15 s
- **Ratio:** 9:16
- **Resolution:** 1080p if your plan allows it, otherwise 720p
- **Audio:** on (room sound only)
- **VO, music and logo:** added in the edit

```text
No uploaded assets; text-to-video.

A 15-second vertical three-shot film: a 7-year-old Armenian girl in a quiet Yerevan apartment at night has a question she cannot answer, finds the answer in a red cloth picture book, and the film ends on three children of different ages reading together under one lamp. Warm, intimate cinematic realism, camera at child eye level, hard cuts at 4s and 9.5s.

THE GIRL (same in every shot): about 7 years old, Armenian, dark brown shoulder-length wavy hair, large dark eyes, light olive skin, soft heather-grey long-sleeved cotton pyjamas.
THE RED BOOK (same in every shot): a square hardcover picture book with a plain deep crimson-red cloth cover, no title and no lettering; inside, full-page painted illustrations of a starry night sky and a small boat, with no readable text.

[0-4s] SHOT 1. Dark bedroom at night. The girl kneels on her bed beside a tall window at frame-left; cold blue moonlight from the window falls on her face; outside, out-of-focus lit windows of pinkish tuff-stone apartment buildings under a dark sky. She presses one palm flat against the glass and looks up at the sky, brows drawn slightly together, lips parted as if about to ask something, then stays still. Camera: 35mm, slow push-in from medium shot to close-up of her face, ending on her upturned eyes. Sound: quiet room tone, faint distant city hum. No other people, no tears.

[4-9.5s] SHOT 2. Hard cut. Top-down close-up, 50mm: the red book lies on a white duvet; her small hands open the cover; a warm amber reading lamp at frame-right lights the open pages showing a painted starry night sky. In one continuous move the camera rises and tilts up from the pages to her face, now lit warm by the lamp and the glow of the page; her eyes move across the page, her brows relax, a small smile forms; the shot ends holding on her smile in close-up. Sound: cloth cover creaking open, one page turning, soft paper rustle. No readable text or letters on the pages.

[9.5-15s] SHOT 3. Hard cut. Wide shot, low camera, 28mm, very slow pull-back. The same apartment: a reading corner on a woven rug under one warm floor lamp at frame-right, the cold blue moonlit window at frame-left. Three children sit close together, each absorbed in their own book: a toddler about 2 years old turning the page of a thick board book with both hands; in the center the same girl in grey pyjamas holding the red book; a teenage boy about 15 in a dark grey hoodie reading a thick paperback novel. The upper 40% of the frame is a calm, empty dark wall in deep black and graphite shadow, clean negative space with nothing in it. From 13.5s the camera stops and the image holds completely still. Sound: low lamp hum, pages turning, soft breathing.

Global: realistic cinematic look, natural skin texture retaining real fine pores, soft film grain, deep black shadows and graphite mid-tones, warm amber lamplight against cold blue moonlight, the red book is the only saturated red in the frame. The girl's face, hair and pyjamas stay identical across all shots. Hard cuts only, no dissolves, no fades. Pure video: no dialogue, no voice, no narration, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no lettering anywhere, no background music; diegetic ambience only. No adults, no extra people, no phones or screens.
```

**Edit timeline:**
- **0–4 s:** window, "Every child has a question nobody answered."
- **4–9.5 s:** book and smile, "We write the books that answer it — in Armenian."
- **9.5–15 s:** three readers. White logo at 9.5 s, then «Գրքեր 0-ից 16 տարեկանների համար» with a thin red #D90429 line at 11.5 s.
- **VO:** placed at its recorded timestamps.
